name: White Monday
source: The reborn tankhead Heiko lives in America with his girlfriend. His relationship is falling apart, he spent all his money on drugs, and his past is catching up with him. The story shows a day in Heiko's life, which is about to get out of hand completely - not entirely unexpectedly.
translation: 重生后的坦克头人海科和女友一起住在美国。他们的关系正走向破裂，他把钱全花在了毒品上，过去的阴影也逐渐追上了他。故事描绘了海科生活中的一天，而这一天即将彻底失控——这倒也并非全然出乎意料。
